# Triplem VIP

> Triplem VIP is a private browser-based accounting and business-finance workspace with operational finance modules, formal Accounting ERP, permission-aware Triplem AI, Financial Timeline, reporting, security controls and international multi-currency support.

This is a public product-discovery map. It contains no private workspace records or authentication secrets.

## Primary references

- [Homepage](https://triplem.vip/index.md): Concise public overview of Triplem VIP and international currency availability.
- [Guide library](https://triplem.vip/seo/index.md): Retrieval-friendly directory of public product and accounting guides.
- [SEO guide map](https://triplem.vip/seo/llms.txt): Structured map for the complete public guide subtree.
- [Full public product reference](https://triplem.vip/llms-full.txt): Expanded product facts, semantics and feature boundaries.

## Key product guides

- [Triplem AI](https://triplem.vip/seo/triplem-ai.md): Permission-aware workspace intelligence, verified record references and reviewable AI Draft workflows.
- [Financial Timeline](https://triplem.vip/seo/financial-timeline.md): Read-only chronological visibility across permitted finance activity.
- [Accounting ERP](https://triplem.vip/seo/accounting-erp.md): Double-entry books, Chart of Accounts, journals, AR/AP, reconciliation, VAT and financial reports.
- [Expense tracking](https://triplem.vip/seo/expense-tracking.md): Expenses, receiving, internal transfers, wallets and multi-currency operations.
- [Financial Audit](https://triplem.vip/seo/financial-audit.md): Cross-module evidence, classifications, VAT review and exports.
- [Security and support](https://triplem.vip/seo/security-and-support.md): Security, 2FA, notifications and support, including public account-protection and recovery information.

## International currency availability

Triplem VIP currently supports finance workflows in AED, SAR, PKR, USD, EUR and INR, with BTC available for supported Bitcoin workflows. India is supported with INR. Belgium and other euro-using markets can use EUR where applicable. If a user in another country needs a currency that is not currently available, they can contact Triplem VIP and its addition can be reviewed. USD remains the regional default where no supported local billing currency applies.
